articles.title: Building India’s deep-tech enterprise pipeline: from IP to IPO
articles.summary: India's startup ecosystem is navigating a more challenging phase, shifting its strategic focus from mere quantitative metrics like startup numbers, patents, or funding rounds. The new emphasis is on evaluating the successful transition of indigenous technologies from laboratory validation to real-world application and commercialisation. This signifies a pivotal move towards fostering deeper, more impactful innovation and tangible technological development within the nation.

articles.title: Rubio Accuses Iran of ‘Nazi U-Boat Tactics’ — Warns It’s ‘Tough to Make a Deal’ with ‘Radical Shia Clerics’
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio accused Iran of employing "Nazi U-boat tactics" against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. He warned that these actions severely hinder the possibility of reaching any agreement with Tehran. This highlights escalating international tensions in a critical global waterway, posing significant challenges to maritime security and diplomatic efforts concerning Iran's regional conduct.
